profile.headline: Software Developer at US Railroad Retirement Board
profile.summary:
I am an IT professional that has been in this industry for more than 30 years. I have worked both as an employee and as a consultant. I have worked in such industries as state government, pharmaceuticals, telecommunications, global securities lending and insurance. 

As a consultant I have worked on a variety of projects and applications always achieving the desired results on-time and within project plan guidelines. I have lead projects as well as developed applications always receiving the highest of acknowledgments from both my co-workers and managers

My goals are to continue to provide professional IT services to my clients or employer.

Specialties: Systems and application analysis, project planning, requirements gathering, system and database design and development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed software applications related to healthcare and retirements benefits for railroad retirees.

positions.title: Developer Analyst
positions.description:
• As a consultant designed and developed system to purge expired   customer relationship data from complex CRM application adhering to strict business rules as well as DB2 referential integrity constraints.

• Designed and implemented enhancements to a legacy warehouse management CICS application to access data stored in DB2 tables instead of IMS databases..

positions.title: Technical Analyst
positions.description:
• Worked with Business Analyst to develop detailed technical design documents and program specifications from detail business requirements for securities lending application
• Developed standards and procedures for completing technical design documents
• Assisted offshore developers in coding and delivering programs according to specifications
• Responsible for developing and executing system test script
• Supported Business Analysts in execution of User Acceptance Test scripts
• Supported the migration and implementation of applications
• Developed stored procedures to support front end PowerBuilder user interface
• Supported user community by resolving SIRs (System Incident Reports)

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
• Supported various enterprise wide departments analyzing, developing, maintaining and modifying applications using COBOL II, DB2, Assembler, IMS DB/DC, JCL. 
• Functioned in project leader and project management roles to develop full life cycle projects. 
• Worked in team environment to convert legacy payroll accounting system to SAP platform using COBOL II, DB2, SPUFI, QMF, DB2 Stored procedures interfacing with VB Script/ASP/Java user interface. 
• Coded numerous COBOL/DB2 applications for Performance Management System, Salary Administration Tool and Managers Desktop Application. 
• Extensive client requirements gathering responsibilities. 
• Rewrite of BAL modules to COBOL II also COBOL IMS modules to COBOL DB2. 
• Conversion of modules using VSAM to RDMS. 
• Support and develop applications for Claims Information System using COBOL CICS.
• Project Lead Developer for client server agents training system responsible for complete system performance. 
• Maintained servers interfacing with ASP front end Siebel Systems CIS application. 
• Maintained the DB2 environment, loading tables, coding load/conversion jobs, backup and restored procedures and maintenance utilities.

educations.schoolName: University of Arkansas at Little Rock
